description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerServerInternalMock for unit testing, which implements the IWebAudioPlayer interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for WebAudioPlayer functionalities such as play, pause, setEos, getBufferAvailable, getBufferDelay, writeBuffer, getDeviceInfo, setVolume, getVolume, and getClient.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternalMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IWebAudioPlayer for testing purposes, providing mocked methods for WebAudioPlayer functionalities.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks the play method to simulate starting playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks the pause method to simulate pausing playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks the setEos method to simulate setting end-of-stream.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks writing data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the client interface.
